# Hyperparameters

```{r}
n_clones <- 100
time_max <- 100
death_rate <- 0.01
grazing_rate <- 0.001
pMHC_degradation_rate <- 0.02
```

# Function for running the simulation

```{r}
run_simulation <- function(
    seed,
    meanlog = -4,
    sdlog = 2.5,
    k_s = 5e-4,
    time_max = 100,
    tau_crit = 1,
    dt = 1
) {

  message("Run seed ", seed)
  set.seed(seed)

  # Generate TCR repertoire with n_clones, each with distinct TCR dwell time
  clones <- tibble(clone = paste0("clone_", seq_len(n_clones)),
                   tau = stats::rlnorm(n = n_clones, meanlog = meanlog, sdlog = sdlog))

  # Probability of productive TCR triggering
  A <- exp(-tau_crit / clones$tau)


  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Helper function for one simulation condition
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------

  simulate_condition <- function(with_inhibition) {

    # T_i(0) = 1 for all recruited clones.
    clone_size <- matrix(0, nrow = n_clones, ncol = time_max)
    clone_size[, 1] <- 1

    # S_i(0) = 0.
    inhibition <- matrix(0, nrow = n_clones, ncol = time_max)

    # C_APC(0) = 1.
    APC <- numeric(time_max)
    APC[1] <- 1

    for (t in 2:time_max) {

      # All rates over this interval are evaluated from the state at the preceding time point: t - 1.
      old_size <- clone_size[, t - 1]
      old_S <- inhibition[, t - 1]
      old_APC <- APC[t - 1]

      total_T <- sum(old_size)

      if (with_inhibition) {
        inhibition_factor <- pmax(0, 1 - old_S)
      } else {
        inhibition_factor <- rep(1, n_clones)
      }

      # Per-cell proliferation rate:
      # A_i * C_APC(t) * max(0, 1 - S_i(t))
      proliferation_rate <- A * old_APC * inhibition_factor

      # Gross production of new cells before subtracting cell death.
      # This is the quantity used as a proxy for productive APC
      # encounters in the pMHC-grazing equation.
      gross_proliferation <- sum(old_size * proliferation_rate)

      # Explicit Euler update of clone abundance:
      # dT_i/dt = T_i * (proliferation_rate_i - death_rate)
      new_size <- old_size + dt * old_size * (proliferation_rate - death_rate)

      # Prevent negative expected cell numbers if an Euler step
      # overshoots below zero.
      clone_size[, t] <- pmax(0, new_size)

      # Explicit Euler update of the inhibitory signal:
      # dS_i/dt = k_s * tau_i * sum_j T_j
      if (with_inhibition) {
        inhibition[, t] <- old_S + dt * k_s * clones$tau * total_T
      } else {
        inhibition[, t] <- 0
      }

      # Explicit Euler update of APC-presented pMHC:
      # dC_APC/dt =
      #   -g * gross_proliferation
      #   -gamma * C_APC
      new_APC <- old_APC + dt * (-grazing_rate * gross_proliferation - pMHC_degradation_rate * old_APC)

      APC[t] <- max(0, new_APC)
    }

    list(
      clone_size = clone_size,
      inhibition = inhibition,
      APC = APC
    )
  }


  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Run WT and no-inhibition simulations with the same TCR repertoire
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------

  simulation_WT <- simulate_condition(with_inhibition = TRUE)

  simulation_no_inhibition <-
    simulate_condition(with_inhibition = FALSE)


  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Convert simulation matrices to a long-format data frame
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------

  prepare_results <- function(simulation, condition) {
  
  simulation$clone_size %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      mutate(clone = clones$clone) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = -clone,
                 names_to = "time",
                 names_prefix = "V",
                 names_transform = list(time = as.integer),
                 values_to = "n") %>%
      mutate(time = time - 1,
           S = as.vector(t(simulation$inhibition)),
           APC = simulation$APC[time + 1],
           type = condition,
           seed = seed) %>%
      left_join(clones, by = "clone")
}


results <- bind_rows(prepare_results(simulation_WT, "WT"),
                     prepare_results(simulation_no_inhibition, "no inhibition")) %>%
  mutate(meanlog = meanlog,
         sdlog = sdlog,
         k_s = k_s,
         tau_crit = tau_crit,
         dt = dt)

  return(results)
}
```

# Grid search for parameters

```{r}
run_grid_search_peak <- function(
    number_of_seeds = 5,
    simulation_time = 50,
    n_cores = 5
) {
  
  parameters_grid <- tidyr::expand_grid(
    seed = seq_len(number_of_seeds),
    meanlog = seq(-8, -2),
    sdlog = seq(1.5, 4.5, 0.5),
    k_s = c(5e-5, 7.5e-5, 1e-4, 2.5e-4, 5e-4)
  )
  
  wrapped_fun <- function(i) {
    
    pars <- parameters_grid[i, ]
    
    simulation <- run_simulation(
      seed = pars$seed[[1]],
      meanlog = pars$meanlog[[1]],
      sdlog = pars$sdlog[[1]],
      k_s = pars$k_s[[1]],
      time_max = simulation_time
    )
    
    peak_times <- simulation %>%
      group_by(type, time) %>%
      summarise(
        total_n = sum(n),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      group_by(type) %>%
      slice_max(
        order_by = total_n,
        n = 1,
        with_ties = FALSE
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      transmute(
        type,
        peak_time = time,
        peak_total_n = total_n,
        peak_at_boundary = peak_time == (simulation_time - 1)
      )
    
    simulation %>%
      inner_join(
        peak_times,
        by = "type"
      ) %>%
      filter(time == peak_time)
  }
  
  results_list <- parallel::mclapply(
    X = seq_len(nrow(parameters_grid)),
    FUN = wrapped_fun,
    mc.cores = n_cores
  )
  
  data.table::rbindlist(
    results_list,
    use.names = TRUE,
    fill = TRUE
  )
}

peak_results <- run_grid_search_peak(
  number_of_seeds = 100,
  simulation_time = 100,
  n_cores = 5
)
```

```{r}
peak_results %>% 
  distinct(meanlog, sdlog, k_s, seed, peak_time, peak_total_n) %>% 
  filter(peak_time != 0) %>% 
  .$peak_time %>% qplot()
```

```{r}
peak_results.top_1 <- peak_results %>% 
  group_by(type, seed, meanlog, sdlog, k_s, peak_time) %>% 
  mutate(freq = n / sum(n)) %>% 
  filter(freq == max(freq)) %>% 
  distinct(type, seed, meanlog, sdlog, k_s, peak_time, .keep_all = T) %>% 
  group_by(type, meanlog, sdlog, k_s) %>% 
  summarise(freq_top1_median = median(freq), 
            n_top1_median = median(n),
            peak_time_median = median(peak_time),
            .groups = "drop")

fitted_parameters <- peak_results.top_1 %>% 
  filter(type == "WT",
         freq_top1_median > .15, freq_top1_median < .17) %>% 
  select(meanlog, sdlog, k_s)
```


```{r, fig.width=6, fig.height=2}
ks_math <- function(x) {
  vapply(x, function(v) {
    exponent <- floor(log10(v))
    coefficient <- signif(v / 10^exponent, 2)
    sprintf("k[s] == %s %%*%% 10^{%d}", coefficient, exponent)
  }, character(1))
}

fig_s3a <- peak_results.top_1 %>% 
  filter(type == "WT") %>% 
  merge(fitted_parameters %>% 
          mutate(fitted = T), all = T) %>% 
  mutate(fitted = replace_na(fitted, F)) %>% 
  arrange(fitted) %>% 
  mutate(k_s_label = factor(ks_math(k_s), levels = ks_math(sort(unique(peak_results.top_1$k_s))))) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = meanlog, y = sdlog, fill = freq_top1_median)) +
  geom_tile(aes(color = fitted), size = .8) +
  facet_wrap(~k_s_label, labeller = label_parsed, nrow = 1) +
  theme_paper +
  scale_fill_viridis_c("Median frequency of \nmost expanded clone", option = "H") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "cyan")) + 
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        legend.box.margin = margin(-4, 0, 0, 0),
        legend.spacing.y = unit(0, "pt"),
        aspect.ratio = 1) + 
  guides(color = "none",
         fill = guide_colourbar(title.position = "left", title.hjust = 0.5, barwidth = unit(30, "mm"), barheight = unit(2, "mm"))) +
  labs(x = expression(mu), y = expression(sigma))

#png("figures/fig_s3a.png", width = 6, height = 2, units = "in", res = 1000)
fig_s3a
#dev.off()
```

```{r, fig.width=2.4, fig.height=2.4}
ks_levels <- c(5e-5, 7.5e-5, 1e-4, 2.5e-4, 5e-4)

ks_labels <- expression(
  5 %*% 10^{-5},
  7.5 %*% 10^{-5},
  1 %*% 10^{-4},
  2.5 %*% 10^{-4},
  5 %*% 10^{-4}
)

fig_s3b_2 <- peak_results.top_1 %>% 
  mutate(k_s = factor(k_s, levels = ks_levels)) %>% 
  dcast(meanlog + sdlog + k_s ~ type, value.var = "freq_top1_median") %>% 
  filter(WT != 0.01) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = WT, y = `no inhibition`, color = k_s)) +
  geom_point(size = .6) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = .4) +
  scale_color_manual(name = expression(k[s]), values = c("grey80", "grey60", "grey40", "grey20", "black"),
                     labels = ks_labels, drop = FALSE, guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 1.5), keyheight = unit(0.25, "cm"))) +
  theme_paper +
  xlim(c(0, 1)) + ylim(c(0,1)) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1) +
  ggtitle("Median frequency of most expanded clone \nSimulation") +
  xlab("WT") + ylab("No inhibition") +
  theme(
    legend.key.height = unit(0.25, "cm"),
    legend.key.width = unit(0.25, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0, "pt"),
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    legend.box.spacing = unit(2, "pt"),
    legend.title = element_text(
      margin = margin(b = 1)
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
    )
  )
```

```{r}
parameters_to_plot <- tibble(
  meanlog = c(-2, -4, -3, -5, -5),
  sdlog = c(1.5, 3.0, 2.0, 3.0, 2.5),
  k_s = c(5e-05, 7.5e-05, 1e-04, 2.5e-04, 5e-04)
)
```

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=2.7}
freq_thr = .001

tau_math <- function(meanlog, sdlog) {
  sprintf(
    "log(tau[i])~'~'~N(mu==%s, sigma==%s)",
    formatC(meanlog, format = "fg", digits = 3),
    formatC(sdlog,  format = "fg", digits = 3)
  )
}

peak_results.ranks <- peak_results %>% 
  merge(parameters_to_plot) %>% 
  group_by(type, meanlog, sdlog, k_s, seed, time) %>% 
  arrange(type, meanlog, sdlog, k_s, seed, time, -n) %>% 
  mutate(rank = rank(-n),
         rank.plot = row_number(),
         frequency = n / sum(n)) %>% 
  mutate(k_s_label = factor(ks_math(k_s), levels = ks_math(sort(unique(peak_results.top_1$k_s)))),
         tau_label = tau_math(meanlog, sdlog)) %>% 
  mutate(type = factor(type, levels = c("WT", "no inhibition"))) 

results_fit.peak.stats <- peak_results.ranks %>% 
  group_by(type, meanlog, sdlog, k_s_label, tau_label, rank.plot) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean_freq = mean(frequency),
    sd_freq = sd(frequency),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(ymin = max(freq_thr, mean_freq - sd_freq),
         ymax = mean_freq + sd_freq) %>% 
  filter(mean_freq >= freq_thr)


fig_s3b <- results_fit.peak.stats %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(aes(x = rank.plot, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = type), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(aes(x = rank.plot, y = mean_freq, color = type), size = 1.2) +
  theme_paper +
  theme_rank_freq +
  scale_x_log10(limits = c(1,20)) + scale_y_log10(limits = c(freq_thr, 1)) +
  facet_wrap(vars(k_s_label, tau_label), labeller = labeller(.default = label_parsed, .multi_line = TRUE), scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        aspect.ratio = 1) +
  scale_color_manual("Simulation", values = c("#1F77B4", "#D62728")) +
  scale_fill_manual("Simulation", values = c("#1F77B4", "#D62728")) +
  xlab("Expansion rank")+ ylab("Clonal frequency") 

#png("figures/fig_s3b.png", width = 7, height = 2.7, units = "in", res = 1000)
fig_s3b
#dev.off()
```

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=2.2}
fig_4a <- simulations_selected %>% 
  filter(seed %in% selected_seeds,
         rank.plot <= 10) %>%
  mutate(seed_plot = factor(seed, levels = selected_seeds, labels = 1:5),
         label = paste0(type, " ", seed_plot),
```
